evidence: regular graph with degree_min = degree_max = 3876 on 8855 receivers
common_neighbours_nonadjacent takes three values (1820, 2380, 3060), consistent with a vertex-transitive family with several distance classes

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1540 for 8855 receivers. The lower bound 1540 is an independent set; the upper bound is a linear code over F_5 with c = 4 (M = I + 4A) of length 1540. All four checks passed (independent_set, code_fits, factorization, decoding). One code was tried, with 2 LLM calls and 1 critic round. Wall time was 30.4 s (llm 21.4 s, compute 9.0 s). Baselines: CP-SAT alpha and CP-SAT cover timed out (about 156 s against a 120 s limit); fractional cover returned only the trivial 8855 after 136 s; F2 minrank SAT gave no bound in 19.9 s. The earlier Kushagra agent also reached 1540/1540 with field 5 in 41.6 s, so this agent was faster (30.4 s) but not more accurate. Nothing suspicious.
